records.title: The duplicate sweep follows ingest option C: a title alone never merges automatically
records.body: {"rule": "exact native titles prove a merge only with agreeing creators (>= 0.92); a summary, an exact cover or a shared identity are the other corroborations", "why": "the sweep could merge specific exact titles when one side named no creator, contradicting hard rule 2 and the 2026-11-02 ingest decision", "where": "TextAutomaticMatchGate; DuplicateTests"}

records.title: New AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER; a custom user header needs it; only the owner changes sign-in settings
records.body: {"rule": "groups come from AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER, Remote-Groups only with Authelia's Remote-User; a custom AUTHELIA_USER_HEADER without a groups header is refused in Settings and gives no groups at runtime; AUTH_*, AUTHELIA_USER_HEADER, AUTH_GROUPS_HEADER and ADMIN_TOKEN are owner-only through the API and are kept on restore", "why": "a non-Authelia proxy may pass Remote-Groups through; an admin could make itself owner"}
